description.en: Meganeura monyi has a long narrow abdomen and four separate broad-based veined wings. Incomplete fossil preservation leaves head details, limb proportions, wing membranes and colour partly inferred rather than an intact living outline.
description.zh: 巨脉蜻蜓 Meganeura monyi 具有狭长腹部和四片独立、基部宽阔且带翅脉的翅。化石保存不完整，头部细节、肢体比例、翅膜及颜色部分依赖推断，并非完整保存的活体轮廓。

construction_notes: Sparse raised veins across thin closed wing meshes, not hundreds of rods. Keep wing outlines legible at final viewer distance.
Simplify incomplete distal venation; do not claim exact taxonomic vein map or copy modern dragonfly-specific detail unsupported by source.
Neutral dark brown body and muted lightly opaque wings are artistic. Calm wings-out resting pose, no prey or swamp scene.

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Museum approximate70cm span; body/thorax dimensions are artistic estimates, not preserved complete measurements.

frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish long narrow abdomen with four broad-based veined wings and a rounded grasping head in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以细长腹部配四片宽基翅及圆形捕食头部搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

shape_gate.en: Its distinguishing construction is long narrow abdomen with four broad-based veined wings and a rounded grasping head; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
shape_gate.zh: 以细长腹部配四片宽基翅及圆形捕食头部为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

scientific_limits.en: Head shape, mandibles, abdomen completion, limb proportions, wing membranes, color and posture are inferred where poorly preserved. Fossil R51142 directly supports wings and partial body, not an intact living outline. Rounded grasping head is the original artistic criterion; exact head details are not established for this specimen. Wingspan is approximate, not a precise measurement.
scientific_limits.zh: 头形、颚、腹部补全、肢体比例、翅膜、颜色及姿态在保存不佳处均属推断。R51142化石直接支持翅与部分身体，而非完整活体轮廓。圆形捕食头部是原美术判据；该标本的精确头部细节并未确定。翼展为近似值而非精确测量。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original Meganeura monyi adult living reconstruction informed by MNHN-F-R51142 fossil wings and museum biological context. Incomplete fossil body/head reconstructed conservatively; not a specimen scan or modern dragonfly copy.
shape_requirements: Original long narrow abdomen, four broad-based veined wings and rounded grasping head retained together.
Four separate gently tapering wing membranes attach in two pairs to thorax; broad wing bases and sparse branching vein geometry must read, not two solid airplane wings.
Small rounded head with paired eyes and restrained mandibular parts, six articulated legs with a few prey-grasping spine cues.
Long segmented tapering abdomen behind compact thorax; no wasp waist, butterfly fan wings, scorpion tail or giant fictional jaws.
frozen_scientific_scope.taxon_scope: Meganeura monyi, MNHN-F-R51142; not Meganeuropsis, Meganeurites or Whalleyala
